metadata.title: Locally Conformal Analysis of Non-Degenerate Odd Pairs
metadata.abstract: We study the locally conformal geometry of cosymplectic and coorientable contact manifolds within a common algebraic framework based on a non-degenerate odd pair: a one-form and a two-form whose appropriate wedge product defines a nowhere-vanishing top-degree form on an odd-dimensional manifold. We consider conformally compatible local geometric and Hamiltonian data and encode their gluing through a closed Lee form and the Lichnerowicz-de Rham differential. For locally conformal cosymplectic geometry, we introduce an equal-weight formulation in which the defining forms carry the same conformal weight. This formulation allows compatible local Hamiltonian vector fields to glue directly into a global Hamiltonian vector field without additional rescaling, thereby preserving the local dynamics. For contact geometry, we develop a twisted odd-pair formulation in which the Lee form records the conformal gluing of local Hamiltonian data, while the global one-form remains an ordinary contact form. We illustrate these constructions through time-dependent mass dynamics in the cosymplectic setting and dissipative particle dynamics in the contact setting.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 局部共形奇数对的统一框架
analysis.workSummary: 作者以一形式和二形式构成非退化odd pair，统一局部共形cosymplectic及共定向接触几何，用闭Lee形式和Lichnerowicz–de Rham微分编码Hamilton数据的粘合。cosymplectic的等权方案使局部Hamilton向量场无需附加缩放即可全局粘合。
analysis.breakthrough: 接触部分以扭odd-pair记录局部Hamilton数据共形变化，同时全局一形式仍为普通接触形式；并有时变质量和耗散粒子实例。
analysis.limitations: 等权、共形相容及闭Lee形式等前提不可省略；统一框架不代表所有局部动力学在任意缩放下不变。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
